title: Visit the farm
eyebrow: A little closer to the animals
headline:
Make a little room
for wonder.
introduction: Step out of the everyday and into the life of Critter Creek. Get in touch with our team to arrange a visit to the sanctuary ranch in Palm City.
alt: Two white goats stand together on the grass at Critter Creek.

sections.heading: Start with a conversation
sections.body: Visits are arranged with the ranch team. Tell us who is coming, your preferred dates, and what you would love to learn about. We will help you work out the details before you come.

sections.heading: A visit built around curiosity
sections.body: Meet the ranch through its animals and the people who care for them. Ask questions, look closely, and learn about the everyday work of a sanctuary. Please follow the team's guidance around animals throughout your visit.

sections.heading: Before you head our way
sections.body: Confirm your visit with the team first. Ask about availability, any fees, group size, accessibility, clothing, and weather arrangements. The current site asks visitors to bring a completed waiver; confirm the latest requirements when booking.

sections.heading: Find us in Palm City
sections.body:
3407 SW Bessey Creek Trail
Palm City, FL 34990

Call (772) 287-8572 or email contact@crittercreekranch.org to arrange your visit.
